story.title: Home Again
story.brief: Your mother asks you to come straight to the house. Danny's things are still in his room.

story.title: Danny's Truck
story.brief: Danny's pickup is still in the impound lot downtown. Bring it home.

story.title: Lupe's Garage
story.brief: Lupe knew Danny. Meet her at Calvera Customs.

story.title: Test Drive
story.brief: A customer's car needs a road test before it goes back. Don't scratch it.

story.title: The Reporter
story.brief: A reporter has been asking about Danny. She wants to meet at the harbor.

story.title: Paper Trail
story.brief: Mara needs files from a Delacroix shipping office. Get in and out.

story.title: Bayou Bait
story.brief: Old Otis ran shrimp with Danny. He'll talk if you help him fill the cooler.

story.title: Gator Country
story.brief: Something has been hitting Otis's traps. Deal with it.

story.title: Where Danny Went
story.brief: Otis saw Danny's skiff go out the night he died. Take a boat and look.

story.title: The Duster
story.brief: Skeeter Boudreaux flies crops out of Redgrass. He saw lights over the bayou that night.

story.title: Low and Slow
story.brief: Ride along: fly the duster over the plains and photograph the landing strip nobody owns.

story.title: Tailing Remy
story.brief: Remy Delacroix drives a gold coupe. Follow him to his meeting.

story.title: A Friendly Warning
story.brief: Captain Voss wants a word at the precinct. Go — it's worse if you don't.

story.title: Errand for Voss
story.brief: Voss says a favor clears the air. Pick up a "package" from a car on the east side.

story.title: Parts Run
story.brief: Lupe's supplier in Mill Creek is short. Bring the engine parts back before close.

story.title: Tomas Ríos
story.brief: Tomas Ríos sends a car for you. He says he knows who killed Danny.

story.title: Proof of Trust
story.brief: Ríos wants a Delacroix van taken off the road.

story.title: The Ledger
story.brief: Mara's office was broken into. Get there before whoever did it gets away.

story.title: Sunday Dinner
story.brief: Your mother insists. Bring something from the lake.

story.title: The Burned Dock
story.brief: Otis shows you where the fire started years ago. It wasn't an accident.

story.title: Ana Delacroix
story.brief: Remy's sister wants to meet in private. She says her family didn't kill Danny.

story.title: Family Business
story.brief: Ana wants proof Voss is double-dealing. Watch his drop at the airfield.

story.title: Night Flight
story.brief: Follow the unmarked plane in Skeeter's duster and see where it lands.

story.title: Shipment
story.brief: Ríos needs a boat run from the bayou to the harbor. No police.

story.title: Remy's Offer
story.brief: Remy Delacroix offers money to walk away. Hear him out.

story.title: Collateral
story.brief: Remy wants a Ríos car burned. You only have to bring it to the lot.

story.title: Armor Up
story.brief: Lupe can armor a car if you bring her one worth armoring.

story.title: Source
story.brief: A dockworker will talk, but men are watching him. Get him clear.

story.title: Hunter's Moon
story.brief: Otis takes you into the forest to talk where no one listens.

story.title: Squeeze
story.brief: Voss sends a cruiser to pick you up. Don't get in it.

story.title: Lake Drop
story.brief: Pick up a waterproof case dropped in Lake Arden.

story.title: The Accountant
story.brief: Ana's accountant has the books on Voss. He's hiding in Mill Creek.

story.title: Crash Site
story.brief: A plane went down in the Sierra Norte. Get there first.

story.title: Front Page
story.brief: Mara publishes. Keep her safe until the paper hits the street.

story.title: Turncoat
story.brief: Ríos thinks you sold him out. Convince him otherwise — or don't.

story.title: Burned Out
story.brief: Someone torched Calvera Customs. Find out who was seen running.

story.title: Leave Town
story.brief: Get your mother out to the lake house until things cool down.

story.title: Gold Coupe
story.brief: Remy's car is the key to his storage unit. Take it.

story.title: Low Tide
story.brief: The smugglers use the bayou channels at low tide. Run them by airboat.

story.title: Ana's Choice
story.brief: Ana asks you to meet her brother with her. It could be a trap.

story.title: The Badge
story.brief: Voss's second-in-command will testify if you get her to the courthouse alive.

story.title: What Danny Knew
story.brief: Danny's notebook is in a safe deposit box. Mara has the key.

story.title: Confession
story.brief: Father Ambrose buried Danny. He has something he never told the police.

story.title: Wings
story.brief: You'll need to move fast. Skeeter teaches you to fly a helicopter.

story.title: Rebuild
story.brief: Lupe is back in business. Buy her a new work truck.

story.title: Last Deal
story.brief: Tomas Ríos wants out of Calvera. Get his family to the airfield.

story.title: The Storage Unit
story.brief: Remy's unit holds the harbor fire evidence. Get it before he moves it.

story.title: Broadcast
story.brief: Channel 9 will air the story if the tape reaches them by helicopter.

story.title: Old Friends
story.brief: Otis is taken by Voss's men. They're holding him at the bayou landing.

story.title: Cornered
story.brief: Voss puts every cruiser in the state on you.

story.title: Mother's Ring
story.brief: Your mother asks for one thing: her ring, sold by Danny to pay a debt. Buy it back.

story.title: Remy Runs
story.brief: Remy is making a run for the Gulf by speedboat. Catch him.

story.title: Family Ties
story.brief: Ana turns on Voss in public. Stay close and keep her alive.

story.title: Getaway Car
story.brief: Lupe builds you the fastest thing in Calvera. Pick it up.

story.title: Air Drop
story.brief: Drop supplies to Otis's people in the bayou.

story.title: Sanctuary
story.brief: Witnesses are hiding at the church. Move them to the lake house.

story.title: Hearing
story.brief: The state hearing starts tomorrow. Get Mara's evidence there.

story.title: The Fire
story.brief: You know who set the dock fire now. So does Voss. He wants to meet at the burned dock.

story.title: Debts Paid
story.brief: Ríos leaves one last thing for you: the plane that brought it all in. Burn it.

story.title: New Harbor
story.brief: Ana wants the harbor run clean. Clear the last of Remy's crew.

story.title: Danny's Boat
story.brief: The family shrimp boat is yours. Take her out on the Gulf one more time.

story.title: Gulf Coast
story.brief: Otis wants a ride along the coast at sunset.

story.title: Southbound
story.brief: Everyone you saved is waiting at the lake house.

side.title: The Lost Retriever
side.brief: Her old retriever, Biscuit, ran off chasing deer into Pinewood Hollow. Find him before dark.

side.title: Grandpa's Skiff
side.brief: His skiff slipped its rope and drifted out on the lake. Bring it back to the shore.

side.title: Wedding Run
side.brief: The groom's car died. Get the bride from Mill Creek to the church downtown.

side.title: Crawfish Boil
side.brief: The boil's tonight and he's short. Catch three fish and bring them out to the bayou.

side.title: Gator in the Pool
side.brief: Something big crawled out of the bayou and won't leave the motel pool. Deal with it.

side.title: Repo Man
side.brief: A customer stopped paying for his sedan. It's parked on the east side. Bring it in.

side.title: Storm Chaser
side.brief: He wants readings from the open plains, and a fast ride out and back.

side.title: Night Fishing
side.brief: Earl's got an order for the fish market and a bad back. Two fish from the lake.

side.title: The Collector
side.brief: A rare record turned up at a pawn shop. Front the money; he pays you back double.

side.title: Moving Day
side.brief: Their moving van is stuck at the impound. Get it out and take it home to Mill Creek.

side.title: Air Mail
side.brief: Lou needs a parcel flown out to the far plains strip and back before the mail plane.

side.who: Big Earl at the Rusty Anchor
side.title: Closing Time
side.brief: Two drunks are tearing up the bar and they've got friends. Help Earl throw them out.

jobs.name: Taxi Driver
jobs.text: Pick up and drop off fares

jobs.name: Bus Driver
jobs.text: Run the downtown loop and stop at every shelter

jobs.name: Parcel Courier
jobs.text: Drop parcels around Mill Creek

jobs.name: Pizza Delivery
jobs.text: Hot pizza for Mill Creek, tight clock

jobs.name: Long-haul Trucker
jobs.text: Haul freight between the city, the town and the airfield

jobs.name: Paramedic
jobs.text: Reach the patient, then get them to Medical Center

jobs.name: Firefighter
jobs.text: Put out fires around the city

jobs.name: Police Patrol
jobs.text: Patrol the checkpoints

jobs.name: Tow Truck Operator
jobs.text: Hook up breakdowns and haul them to the impound

jobs.name: Garbage Collector
jobs.text: Empty the bins around Mill Creek

jobs.name: Road Crew
jobs.text: Fix potholes at the work sites

jobs.name: Mechanic
jobs.text: Fix customer cars around the Mill Creek garage

jobs.name: Bike Messenger
jobs.text: Run envelopes between offices on foot

jobs.name: Security Guard
jobs.text: Check every door on your round

jobs.name: Fishing Charter Captain
jobs.text: Take clients out to the fishing grounds and back

jobs.name: Commercial Fisherman
jobs.text: Land three fish from the bayou for the market

jobs.name: Hunting Guide
jobs.text: Bag and skin two animals for your clients

jobs.name: Crop Duster Pilot
jobs.text: Spray the fields (fly low through the markers)

jobs.name: Air Tour Pilot
jobs.text: Show tourists the lake, downtown and the coast

jobs.name: Medevac Pilot
jobs.text: Fly to the accident, land, and bring the patient back

jobs.name: Lumberjack
jobs.text: Fell the marked trees (needs a chainsaw)

jobs.name: Landscaper
jobs.text: Mow and trim yards around Mill Creek

jobs.name: Construction Worker
jobs.text: Frame, drill and fasten at the site

jobs.name: Electrician
jobs.text: Service calls: wiring and panels

jobs.name: Plumber
jobs.text: Service calls around Mill Creek: leaks and clogs

jobs.name: Paper Route
jobs.text: The Calvera Courier, door to door around Mill Creek

jobs.name: Ranch Hand
jobs.text: Check fences and round up strays across the plains

jobs.name: Bounty Hunter
jobs.text: Track down the fugitive and take them out
